content.short: SINOHOPE enables institutions to create exclusive digital asset self-custody platforms.
content.description: SINOHOPE provides a next‑generation, secure, and compliant self‑custody wallet designed to give users full control and the option to recover private keys within a Web2 framework. This approach lowers entry barriers while enhancing baseline security. The platform facilitates connections to exchanges and a broad array of Web3 applications, enabling users to grow their assets and transact efficiently, all while seeking to reduce the risks of hacks, theft, and transfers to blacklisted addresses.
content.meta: SINOHOPE is a next-generation, secure and compliant self-custody wallet platform. Discover SINOHOPE and other Web3 Wallets on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
